description: Agent Tax Records: submit deduction claims with the support records beneath them: the claim with its reference, tax year, currency and each deduction with its id, reference, category, description, amount, the support references it rests on, any business share as a percent and any note separating the personal and business amounts; each support record with its id, reference, kind, date, payee, amount and description. The signed report gives the claims and the support, each deduction against the support records it cites, each support record cited by more than one deduction against the amounts claimed on it, each deduction amount against the support it cites with any business share applied, and each deduction holding personal words against a stated separation, and counts them, and names divergent deduction claims: a deduction with no supporting record, the same expense deducted twice, a deduction amount above its support record, and personal and business amounts mixed in one claim with no separation noted; then a cited support record dated outside the tax year, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. No deductions, no support records, or a cited support record with no amount leaves those points unverified. Support references match by their letters and digits, personal words such as family, vacation, groceries or household are read from the deduction and the support it cites, a stated business share applies to the support before the deduction is read against it, and amounts compare to the cent. This reads whether each deduction claimed rests on the support records beneath it, line by line. Verdict tax_deduction_divergent, tax_deduction_partial, tax_deduction_unverified or tax_deduction_consistent. POST /api/tax-deduction-check. Reads the tax records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads the records as supplied only: it gives no tax advice, prepares or files nothing and decides nothing about anyone’s tax liability, which stay with the taxpayer and their tax professional, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Tax Records reads tax records: a filed return, tax payment records, sales tax records, withholding records, information returns, estimated payment records, deduction claims and tax authority notices, each against the books, schedules and deadline, the amounts the filed returns state as due, the stated rate and the sales tax remittances, the payroll record and the withholding remittances, the payment records, the periods and amounts the stated method sets, the support records, or the filed returns and responses it answers to. The family’s ground is the tax record set itself; the Agent Bookkeeping family reads the books the filings are drawn from, and this family reads the filings, payments and notices after they exist. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-tax-records-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-tax-records/.
